title: Layout library (reference)
note: Not a publishable piece. These are 14 archetypes to combine. Sample copy: always replace it.

slides.alt: Typographic cover with a large headline and an accent circle that runs off the edge.
Cover with a full-bleed photo of a silhouette facing a sunset and the headline on top.
A statement in large type on a dark background with an accent line.
A large number with the line that explains it.
Numbered list of four steps separated by lines.
Two columns: before and now, three points each.
A photo in the top half and a text card below.
Horizontal bar chart with four stages and their hours.
A quote in quotation marks with the name and role of the person who said it.
A closing line and a specific call to action.
Four cards with news items and, below, the title of the weekly issue.
A headline and a drawn software window with a list of five pieces and their status.
A headline and a grid of six customer logos.
Background photo with the names of two brands joined by a cross, and one line of text.
